title: EBP section 12 - Models

container.notes: EBP section 12 (models; no magic: u32 entryCount, then entryCount s32 model ids from 0x04, zero padding to 16). EBP = *.ebp, 0x80-byte header: magic 'EBP2' at 0x00, twenty u32 section offsets at 0x10-0x5F counted from the EBP start (0 = absent; this section = u32 at EBP+0x40), 0x04-0x0F and 0x60-0x7F not interpreted. Sections start on 16-byte boundaries with zero fill; a section spans to the next larger non-zero offset (the highest to end of file), so the span includes padding. Section 6 is a TIM2 texture and section 19 an embedded ARD (FF12AR03); a rebuild must carry both. Little-endian throughout.

records.name: modelsHeader
records.where: Offset 0 of EBP section 12 (EBP start + u32 at EBP+0x40).

fields.name: entryCount
fields.notes: Number of 4-byte model ids that follow immediately (no magic, no gap).

fields.name: model
fields.notes: Model id. Assumed to use the usual (ASCII prefix letter << 16) | file number encoding of the Toolkit ModelList; not confirmed for EBP lists.

roundTrip: Edit ids in place; the list has no internal pointers.
Keep the bytes after the last id (padding) as read while the count does not change.
When ids are added or removed: update entryCount, rewrite the ids contiguously from 0x04 and zero-pad the section to a multiple of 16 (size = 4 + 4n rounded up).
Keep the existing order of ids (nothing documents whether the script or other sections index this list).

If the section length changes, every EBP section stored after it moves: recompute their u32 slots at EBP+0x10+4n, keep 16-byte starts with zero fill, keep absent sections at 0, keep section 6 (TIM2) and section 19 (ARD) intact.
gaps: Whether the ids use the ModelList encoding; a trap script calls modelread(0x3000001) (Discord msg 117), an id that does not fit that encoding.
Whether every model the script reads (modelread) must be listed here, and whether list order matters.
Whether vanilla pads the section to 16 bytes (the Workshop always does).
